name: core_exact_law_mae
requirement: Full-estimate exact-law validation must be near numerical precision.

name: moment_hierarchy_exactness
requirement: Moment-law prediction should be exact up to floating-point error when using the full empirical distribution.

name: expanded_pilot_proxy_K128_N8
requirement: Existing 256-sample proxy is diagnostic pre-flight evidence for the pilot-forecasting target, not final proof.

name: expanded_pilot_proxy_K256_N8
requirement: Existing 256-sample proxy is diagnostic pre-flight evidence for the pilot-forecasting target, not final proof.

name: maxed_heldout_coverage
threshold: all target model/problem records measured at manifest sample depth
requirement: The maximum held-out forecasting claim requires complete manifest-scale coverage, not one deep record.

name: maxed_heldout_K128_N8
requirement: Maxed-out held-out forecasting must hit the paper's sample-complexity gate on independent evaluation.

name: maxed_heldout_K256_N8
requirement: Maxed-out held-out forecasting must hit the paper's sample-complexity gate on independent evaluation.

name: maxed_heldout_K512_N8
requirement: Maxed-out held-out forecasting must hit the paper's sample-complexity gate on independent evaluation.

name: live_judge_delta_over_logprob
requirement: A real judge/verifier should beat mean logprob by at least +0.03 at high N.

name: maxed_live_judge_coverage
requirement: Maxed-out live-judge claim needs complete model/problem coverage for the live panel.

name: cross_benchmark_exact_law
requirement: Every completed benchmark should hit the exact-law MAE and grading-coverage gate.

name: cross_benchmark_family_count
requirement: The maximum generalization claim needs at least six benchmark families.

name: maxed_cross_benchmark_scale
threshold: 6 families at manifest task limit, sample depth, model count, and 100% measured coverage
requirement: The maximum cross-benchmark claim requires the manifest-scale run, not smoke-scale family presence.

name: adaptive_allocation_delta
requirement: Moment-law allocation should beat uniform under fixed budget.
